cases.note: Static structure case only. 0x004A50F5 is the retail CRT entry (WinMainCRTStartup): GetVersion, heap and runtime init, GetCommandLineA, GetStartupInfoA, then main, then exit, inside an SEH frame (scope table 0x534308, handler 0x4a67ec). The candidate keeps that call order. No runtime run exists: the entry runs once before a Frida probe can attach.
